starting-the-2005-easter-event.text: If the player completed the event in the previous 10 minutes:

steps.npc: Thanks for your help!  You should have a break now.  Come back in [number] minutes if you want to hand out more eggs.

starting-the-2005-easter-event.npc: But I'm afraid I've left things a bit late this year.  I'm going to need some help to get all these eggs delivered!  Would you help me, [player name]?

steps.text: If the player's inventory is full:

steps.npc: Oh dear, you don't have any free inventory space.  Talk to me again when you have.

steps.text: If the player has a rubber chicken equipped, in their inventory or in their bank:

steps.npc: Splendid, splendid!  Here's a basket of eggs.  Hand out as many as you can before they disappear and then come back to me.  You've only got two minutes!

steps.text: If the player does not have a rubber chicken:

steps.npc: Splendid, splendid!  Here's a basket of eggs.  Hand out as many as you can before they disappear and then come back to me for your reward.  You've only got two minutes!
Oh dear oh dear!  I've got to hurry!

while-holding-the-easter-basket.npc: Quickly, [player name]!  Hand out those eggs before they vanish!

after-the-timer-has-run-out-if-no-eggs-w.npc: Oh dear, [player name]. You didn't hand out any eggs at all! Do you want to try again?

after-the-timer-has-run-out-if-at-least-.text: If the player has a rubber chicken equipped, in their inventory or in their bank:

steps.npc: Thank you, [player name]!  You handed out [number] eggs!

after-the-timer-has-run-out-if-at-least-.text: If the player does not have a rubber chicken:

steps.npc: Thank you, [player name]!  You handed out [number] eggs!  Here is your Easter reward!

steps.text: The Easter bunny gives you a rubber chicken.

steps.npc: If you lose it, you can get another one from Diango in Draynor.
